description: Deletes a company template, as the app's Templates drawer does. Reports already built in it keep their look; new ones can no longer start in it. Its creator, or an admin for a shared one, may.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

templateId.description: The company template to act on, by its `id` from `listTemplates`. Rollstack's own template can't be changed.

name: deleteTemplate
title: Delete template
